A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the determinants of trust and its role in influencing behavioral intent are not universal across Web sites and across consumers.
the design strategies for building trust in a Web environment are not universal across Web site categories.
trust is an important determinant of consumer behavior in the Internet environment, and it is driven by both the characteristics of the Web site and the characteristics of the customer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the drivers of online trust are different for different Web site categories, as well as for different segments of consumers.
Web sites should focus their design efforts on the drivers of trust that are most important to their customers, and that these drivers vary across different types of Web sites.
Web sites should be designed to address the specific drivers of trust for their category and their customer segments.
